# Where these came from

Vanilla data pack JSON from [misode/mcmeta](https://github.com/misode/mcmeta), tag `1.21.4-data`,
under `data/minecraft/`. This is the same source and the same shape that
[misode.github.io](https://misode.github.io/)'s data pack generators emit, so the loader's adapters are
validated against real generator output rather than against a hand-written sample.

Refetch with `node scripts/fetch-misode-fixtures.mjs` after changing `REF`.
